Sum of 8 on Two Dice: Class 10 board exam ka dice wala probability question, solved on a 6 × 6 grid, step by step.

• Total outcomes: 6 × 6 = 36
• Sum 8: (2,6), (3,5), (4,4), (5,3), (6,2), so 5 favourable outcomes
• (4,4) counts once; (2,6) and (6,2) are different outcomes
• P(sum = 8) = favourable / total = 5/36
